units.source_text: “真是对不起，那就请到茶室这边来吧。

en.t: “I am very sorry. In that case, please come this way to the tea room.

units.source_text: 我以为你觉得无聊，就送了碗茶来，如果茶室合适的话，请在那儿用茶吧。”

en.t: I thought you might be bored, so I brought some tea; if the tea room will do, please have it there.”

units.source_text: 我跟着夫人出了书房。

en.t: I followed his wife out of the study.

units.source_text: 茶室里，铁壶在锃亮的火盆上咝咝作响。

en.t: In the tea room, an iron kettle hissed over a gleaming brazier.

units.source_text: 夫人请我吃了茶点，夫人怕喝茶睡不着觉，没有喝。

en.t: His wife served me tea and sweets, but she did not drink any herself, fearing the tea would keep her from sleeping.

units.source_text: “先生还是常常出门赴这样的聚会吗？”

en.t: “Does Sensei still often go out to gatherings like this?”

units.source_text: “不，很少出去。

en.t: “No, he hardly ever goes out.

units.source_text: 近来他好像越来越讨厌和人见面了。”

en.t: Lately he seems to dislike seeing people more and more.”

units.source_text: 夫人说话时，并没有显出不悦的样子，我就壮着胆子问道：

en.t: As she said this, his wife showed no sign of displeasure, so I took courage and asked:

units.source_text: “那么，只有夫人是例外吧？”

en.t: “Then you alone are the exception, I suppose?”

units.source_text: “不是的，我也是被他讨厌的一个。”

en.t: “No. I am one of the people he dislikes too.”

units.source_text: “那不是实话，”我说，“我看夫人是明知那不是实话，还要这样说吧。”

en.t: “That is not true,” I said. “I think you know it is not true and are saying it anyway.”

units.source_text: “为什么这么说？”

en.t: “Why do you say that?”

units.source_text: “让我说的话，先生就是因为喜欢夫人才厌恶这个社会的。”

en.t: “In my view, Sensei dislikes society precisely because he loves you.”

units.source_text: “你不愧是个做学问的人，很会强词夺理啊。

en.t: “You really are a scholar; you are very good at twisting logic.

units.source_text: 按照你这个逻辑，不是也可以说，因为他厌恶这个社会，所以连我也一起讨厌了吗？

en.t: By that logic, could one not also say that because he dislikes society, he has come to dislike even me as well?

units.source_text: 一样的道理。”

en.t: It is the same reasoning.”

units.source_text: “这两种说法都说得过去，不过，在这个问题上，我是正确的。”

en.t: “Both explanations may be possible, but in this case I am the one who is right.”

units.source_text: “我不喜欢争论。

en.t: “I do not like arguments.

units.source_text: 经常看到男人们争论不休，好像多有趣似的，居然拿着空酒杯没完没了地交杯换盏。”

en.t: I often see men argue endlessly as if it were great fun, passing empty cups back and forth without ever tiring of it.”
